'''Corporal Ballala''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He sold weapons in [[Bugtown]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ballala appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
